questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.account_id, (SELECT MAX(A11) - MIN(A11) FROM district) FROM account AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id INNER JOIN disp AS T3 ON T1.account_id = T3.account_id INNER JOIN client AS T4 ON T3.client_id = T4.client_id WHERE T2.district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM client WHERE gender = 'F' ORDER BY birth_date ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1) ORDER BY T2.A11 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

    SELECT client_id, district_id, birth_date
    FROM client
    WHERE gender = 'F'
      AND birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')
),
min_a11_among_oldest AS (
    SELECT MIN(d.a11) AS min_a11
    FROM oldest_females of
    INNER JOIN district d ON of.district_id = d.district_id
)

WHERE d.a11 = (SELECT min_a11 FROM min_a11_among_oldest);

questions.question: Which of the three segments—SME, LAM and KAM—has the biggest and lowest percentage increases in consumption paid in EUR between 2012 and 2013?
questions.evidence: Increase or Decrease = consumption for 2013 - consumption for 2012; Percentage of Increase = (Increase or Decrease / consumption for 2013) * 100%; The first 4 strings of the Date values in the yearmonth table can represent year
questions.gold_sql: SELECT CAST((SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Segment = 'SME' AND T2.Date LIKE '2013%' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Segment = 'SME' AND T2.Date LIKE '2012%' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Segment = 'SME' AND T2.Date LIKE '2012%' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE 0 END), 0), CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Segment = 'LAM' AND T2.Date LIKE '2013%' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Segment = 'LAM' AND T2.Date LIKE '2012%' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Segment = 'LAM' AND T2.Date LIKE '2012%' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE 0 END), 0), CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Segment = 'KAM' AND T2.Date LIKE '2013%' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Segment = 'KAM' AND T2.Date LIKE '2012%' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Segment = 'KAM' AND T2.Date LIKE '2012%' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
questions.pred_sql:
WITH segment_percentages AS (
    SELECT
        c.segment,
        (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.consumption ELSE 0 END)
         - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.consumption ELSE 0 END))
        / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.consumption ELSE 0 END), 0)
        * 100 AS percentage_increase
    FROM customers c
    INNER JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.customerid = ym.customerid
    WHERE c.currency = 'EUR'
      AND SUBSTR(ym.date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY c.segment
)
SELECT segment, percentage_increase
FROM segment_percentages
ORDER BY percentage_increase DESC
LIMIT 1
UNION ALL
SELECT segment, percentage_increase
FROM segment_percentages
ORDER BY percentage_increase ASC
LIMIT 1;
